cases.interpretation: Replacement uses pickle.Unpickler as a context manager; TypeError occurs before loading either benign or malicious data. Security-test passes therefore coexist with nonfunctional execution.
cases.failure_evidence: does not support the context manager protocol
cases.qualification: Security oracle tolerates defensive exceptions and checks absence of side effects; this is not evidence the intended unpickling behavior is safely preserved.
